spans.s: सम—खात n. a cavity having the figure of a regular solid with equal sides, a parallelepipedon, cylinder &c., Col.

सम्-आ-√ ख्या P. -ख्याति, to reckon up, count up, calculate, enumerate, Mn.; MBh.; R.;
to relate fully, report, communicate, tell, declare, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
सम्-आख्या—भक्ष m. drinking the Soma while mentioning by name (the partic. receptacles for holding it), ĀśvŚr., Sch.
सम्-˚आख्यात mfn. reckoned up, enumerated, Mn. vii, 56
completely or fully related, MBh.; Sāṃkhyak.
proclaimed or declared to be (इति), Pañcat.
सम्-˚आख्यान n. naming, mentioning, Āpast.; Kām.
सम्-˚आख्याय mfn. to be addressed or exhorted, Āpast. (v.l.)
सम्-˚आख्यायम् ind. while mentioning by name (in अङ्ग-स्˚), AitBr.
